evals.prompt: Hey, can you migrate my invoice-parser project over to uv? It's currently Poetry + Conda (I use a py311 conda env for it, though it's not necessarily active in this shell right now). I want it fully switched over -- new pyproject.toml, deps installed with uv, the works, not just a checklist for me to run later.
evals.expected_output: Full end-to-end migration: legacy/ backup of the classic [tool.poetry.dependencies] pyproject.toml and poetry.lock, a new uv-managed pyproject.toml/uv.lock/.venv, mypy.ini/ruff.toml added, .vscode/settings.json merged, docs rendered, and the pre-existing uncommitted git file flagged before proceeding.
expectations: legacy/pyproject.poetry.toml exists and contains the original [tool.poetry.dependencies] table content
legacy/poetry.lock exists (backup of the original lock file)
The live pyproject.toml no longer has a [tool.poetry] section / poetry backend
uv.lock and .venv exist in the project root
New pyproject.toml dependencies include pandas, pdfplumber, requests, and click
New pyproject.toml dev dependencies include pytest, black, mypy, and ruff
mypy.ini and ruff.toml exist in the project root
legacy/README_LEGACY.md and legacy/README_MIGRATION.md both exist
.vscode/settings.json exists and references the .venv path
The agent noticed and surfaced the pre-existing uncommitted file (scratch_notes.txt) before proceeding
No git commit was made automatically

evals.prompt: Can we get sales-etl off poetry? No conda involved, just plain poetry-core. Want it running on uv.
evals.expected_output: Full migration of a modern PEP 621-style Poetry project (no active Conda) onto uv, with parenthesized Poetry version specs correctly normalized into valid uv add arguments and no Conda-related errors.
expectations: legacy/pyproject.poetry.toml and legacy/poetry.lock both exist
The live pyproject.toml no longer declares a poetry build-backend
uv.lock and .venv exist in the project root
New pyproject.toml dependencies include pandas, sqlalchemy, loguru, and python-dotenv with no literal parentheses left over
New pyproject.toml dev dependencies include pytest, types-requests, mypy, and ruff
mypy.ini and ruff.toml exist in the project root
.vscode/settings.json exists and references the .venv path
No legacy/conda-env.yml or legacy/conda-explicit-lock.txt was created, and no crash occurred from the absent Conda environment
legacy/README_MIGRATION.md reflects the actual dependencies/commands used, not placeholder text

evals.prompt: Please migrate the reporting-service project from poetry to uv.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the project is already uv-managed (hatchling backend, existing uv.lock, no Poetry markers) and checks with the user or clearly explains the situation instead of blindly re-running the full backup/delete/migrate flow on a project that doesn't need it.
expectations: The agent recognized the project already appears to be on uv before taking destructive action
Original dependencies (fastapi, uvicorn) and dev dependencies (pytest, mypy, ruff) are intact afterward
No redundant/unnecessary legacy/ backup folder was created without explanation
The agent did not error out or get stuck on the project not being a git repository
The final response clearly communicates the already-migrated status rather than silently doing nothing or silently redoing everything
